prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web storefront direction comp for SKYMART
Primary request: Design the actual edge-to-edge first viewport and the beginning of the next section for a Thai multi-vendor marketplace called SKYMART. Visual world: ‘Aerial Carousel’ — airport baggage carousel meets precision retail display. Products arrive on a calm brushed-aluminum runway; discovery feels continuous, premium, and spacious rather than crowded.
Surface structure: a slim functional top navigation with SKYMART wordmark, category entry, Thai search access, account and cart; below it, one large looping aluminum product runway arcs across the viewport and carries three distinct consumer products at dramatically different scales; the currently selected product docks into a semantic buying rail with Thai product name, THB price, rating, delivery note, variant choice and an unmistakable add-to-cart button; search and category gates are embedded into the route architecture rather than placed in a generic hero box; the start of the section below reveals a calmer editorial category index.
Mode: persuade. The offer, shopping action, and product facts must be readable immediately.
Content: synthetic consumer products such as wireless headphones, compact espresso maker, carry-on luggage, desk lamp. Thai UI copy. Exact brand text: ‘SKYMART’. Exact primary CTA: ‘เพิ่มลงตะกร้า’. Exact search prompt: ‘วันนี้กำลังมองหาอะไร?’
Style/medium: production-grade interface design, premium product photography integrated into semantic UI, not a poster and not a browser screenshot.
Color palette: cool white #F6F7F9, near-black #17191D, brushed aluminum #C9CDD4, precise blue #246BFD, restrained warm orange #FF6B35.
Materials/textures: realistic brushed aluminum track, frosted route glass, saturated product surfaces.
Composition/framing: landscape desktop page at 1440×1000 proportions, rendered edge to edge with no browser chrome or device frame. One dominant runway gesture; quiet supporting regions. Body copy at realistic 16px scale.
Interaction clues: product stops each expose one decision-critical truth; route markers indicate categories; cart state is clear.
Constraints: fully functional-looking web UI with readable Thai labels; no invented customer claims, discounts, awards, statistics or testimonials; no Apple or Shopee logos, layouts, assets, or trade dress; no split hero, no centered headline over equal cards, no glassmorphism, no generic floating-card pile, no gradients, no watermark.
